scoring_justification: Result-level compare: the agent's reported polarizabilities are compared against the paper's computed values with relative tolerance, as recomputing the full variational minimization within the lightweight checker is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold static dipole polarizabilities (in atomic units) for H-, F-, Cl-, Br-, I- from paper Table I (Present work column)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results.

outputs.description: Static dipole polarizabilities computed by the variational density-functional method for the ions H⁻, F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻, I⁻.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare each ion's polarizability against hidden reference values using relative error tolerance.
